caseNameFull: Connell, Chairman, National Credit Union Administration Board v. American Bankers Assn.

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of San Diego Federal Savings & Loan Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and petition.
